drhp.business: Sri KPR Industries Ltd. has discontinued its earlier business of selling A.C. Pressure Pipes and no longer holds Government Drinking Water Supply Scheme contracts except operation & maintenance of one scheme. It currently earns income from the sale of wind power generated in Andhra Pradesh, including through its wholly owned subsidiary Sri KPR Infra & Projects Ltd. and step-down subsidiary Sri Pavan Energy Pvt. Ltd., which supplies wind power to Central Railways.
drhp.expansion: The Company has an approved but dormant plan to convert its factory land into an open plot layout/villa project; the resolution was approved via postal ballot (30.6.2022) and at the 37th AGM (30.9.2025), but the project could not be grounded due to a slump in the real estate market and will be taken up once the market revives. No other capacity addition, commissioning or ramp-up plan is disclosed in this bundle.

litigation.note: Claim for compensation over the collapse of a 2 MW Wind Mill in Madhya Pradesh is pending before the Hon'ble Arbitral Tribunal; in June 2026 Siemens Gamesa Renewable Power Pvt. Ltd came forward for settling the dispute through discussions/negotiations, still in progress (MD&A / Board's Report, Industry Structure and Developments).
